==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Borrguus Blisterbark in [[Sacnoth Valley]].
* *BONUS* Kill Borrguus Blisterbark in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* 1,250 [[Ebon Vanguard rank|Vanguard reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.
